subject: CloudScale SI-sponsored trial — activation logistics
messages:
From: Ibrahim Rahman <ibrahim@cloudscale.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SI-sponsored trial credits for Acme Corp POC

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well — following up from our call yesterday. CloudScale is sponsoring a short PoC for Acme Corp (they're evaluating inference for their CX automation) and we’d like Redwood to provision a 6-week trial with $10k in promotional credits under CloudScale’s partner allocation. Acme will need dedicated API keys scoped to the trial, and our engineering lead (cc'd) will validate data handling.

High level details:
- Pilot name: Acme + CloudScale PoC
- Start date: target Aug 15
- Duration: 6 weeks
- Requested credits: $10,000 promotional credit (partner-sponsored)
- Use case: chat + embeddings (heavy embeddings footprint first 2 weeks)

Attached: CloudScale_SOW_v1.pdf and a signed POA that authorizes CloudScale to request partner promo credits on behalf of Acme. Let me know if you need a different format.

Thanks — can you confirm the activation flow and whether Redwood requires a signed MSA from Acme for this promo?

Best,
Ibrahim Rahman
Partnerships, CloudScale Systems
ibrahim@cloudscale.io
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2025 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SI-sponsored trial credits for Acme Corp POC

Ben/Kim,

Looping you in — CloudScale (partner) wants to sponsor a $10k promo credit for an Acme PoC starting Aug 15. Ibrahim attached an SOW and POA. Can we do the following?

1) Confirm whether we can issue partner-sponsored promo credits to an external customer (Acme) under CloudScale's entitlements and what the minimal compliance checks are (we have the POA).
2) Create a dedicated trial API key + project scope that limits embedding calls to the first 2 weeks and enforces rate limits.
3) Provide an activation ETA so Ibrahim can align internal SIs and schedule the kickoff.

If we need legal sign-off (MSA) from Acme, flag here — Acme wants a fast lane.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Partner Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2025 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SI-sponsored trial credits for Acme Corp POC

Tessa —

Quick notes from infra/ops perspective: we can do partner-sponsored promos but need a couple artifacts in place before provisioning:
- Verified POA naming CloudScale and the external account (we have CS-Partner-POA.pdf attached).
- The customer account (Acme) must exist in billing as a linked account with an assigned internal account ID.
- Provide a target project name and whether they need a sandbox VPC/Private mode (if they want isolation).

Proposed activation timeline if docs arrive by COB Aug 11: provisioning and key issuance Aug 14, live by Aug 15.

I can create an isolated project and set an embedding quota for first 2 weeks. Kim — can you confirm any finance approvals for partner-funded promos of this size?

-Ben

Attachments: CS-Partner-POA.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SI-sponsored trial credits for Acme Corp POC

Ben/Tessa —

Finance OK on partner-sponsored promos up to $15k for strategic SI-led PoCs if there is a signed POA and a verified partner SOW. I do need:
- A billing ledger note that credit will be redeemed against CloudScale's partner pool (please tag as CloudScale-PSP-2025).
- A quick one-line approval from Revenue Ops confirming Acme is not on a sanctions watchlist (I will ping them).

If those checks pass, I approve the $10k issuance. Please proceed with the activation ETA Ben proposed.

-Kim

Signature:
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ibrahim Rahman <ibrahim@cloudscale.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@cloudscale.io, elena.chen@acme.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI-sponsored trial credits for Acme Corp POC

Thanks, Tessa/Ben/Kim — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is a signed SOW and the POA (same files but attached for your records).

Acme contact: Elena Chen (elena.chen@acme.com) — she’s cc’d and will co-ordinate their internal onboarding. Acme does not require a separate MSA for this trial — they will sign a short PoC addendum, but nothing blocking.

For the sandbox, Acme prefers a shared hosted trial (no VPC) to keep initial friction low. Project name: acme-cs-poc-aug2025.

Please confirm the account ID when ready and whether Redwood will restrict embedding tokens after week 2 automatically.

Best,
Ibrahim
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Ibrahim Rahman <ibrahim@cloudscale.io>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, elena.chen@acme.com
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI-sponsored trial credits for Acme Corp POC — activation confirmed

Hi Ibrahim/Elena —

All good on our side. Finance cleared the credit ($10,000) against CloudScale's partner pool (ledger tag: CloudScale-PSP-2025). We created the trial project: acme-cs-poc-aug2025 (Account ID: RWI-7821-A).

Provisioning summary:
- Promotional credit: $10,000 applied to RWI-7821-A, valid Aug 15 — Sep 26 (6 weeks).
- API key: rwi-trial-acme-aug25 (sent via secure channel to Elena).
- Embeddings quota: Hard limit of 250M embedding tokens for first 14 days, then relaxed automatically for the remaining period.
- Rate limits: 60 rps with 1k concurrent token window.
- Billing note: Redeem from CloudScale partner pool.

Attached is a copy of the activation confirmation and SOW receipt. If you need the API key resent via DocuSign or a different secure flow, notify us and we'll update.

Welcome aboard — Tessa will follow up to schedule the technical kickoff with CloudScale and Acme.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: activation_receipt_acme_rwi-7821.pdf
